messages:
Noah: kicking off a quick onboarding thread for quetzal-emb-v1. main checks: recall@1/5/10, int4 vs int8 vs fp16, clustering sanity, and short-query regression.
Leah: dataset mix?
Noah: cc: wiki-snips (3k), customer-faqs (1k), search-short holdout (400 short queries).
Ivy: ran a vertex micro-run yesterday: int4 (perchannel) gave large compression on near-neighbors. cosine shift ~0.022.
Diego: can you paste the command?
Ivy: `./run_eval --model quetzal-emb-v1 --slices short,all --quant int4_perchannel --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_shift,silhouette --out /tmp/qz-int4.json`
Noah: thanks. I'll parallelize the harness onto staging-gpu-5.
ops-bot: Deploy: quetzal-emb-v1 -> staging-canary (15% traffic). watch window 45m. :eyes:
Leah: initial micro-report from Ivy pasted: 
```
fp16 Recall@1: 0.672
int8 Recall@1: 0.659 (-0.013)
int4 Recall@1: 0.632 (-0.040)
Recall@5: fp16=0.826, int8=0.812, int4=0.779
Cosine mean shift: int4=0.022, int8=0.009
Silhouette (k=200): fp16=0.41, int8=0.39, int4=0.30
```
Diego: int4 seems rough. are failures concentrated in short queries?
Ivy: yes — short queries (<=6 tokens) Recall@1 drop for int4 ~6%. we see many nearest neighbors collapsing to a small radius.
Noah: product note: short-query recall is user-facing for our search product; anything >3% drop is risky.
Leah: QA-bot ran regression harness overnight and flagged 28 queries with embedding norm=0 after normalization (possible underflow). ticket ML-4701 created.
qa-bot: Regression summary: 28/450 short queries produced zero-vector after L2 norm clip; affected mostly int4 quantized runs.
Diego: ops: can we enable fallback routing to opal-v2 for short queries until we triage?
ops-bot: Fallback rule added to staging-canary: route short_query=true to opal-v2 if short_recall_delta > 0.03 within 30m.
Ivy: plan: run int4 per-channel with higher dynamic range (adjust clip_scale +0.15) and also try int8-perchannel asymmetric.
Noah: also add kd-tree based nearest-neighbor check for tiny radii — helps detect collapsed neighborhoods.
Leah: I'll push an artifact with UMAP + density heatmaps. early visual shows a dense blob near origin for int4.
Ivy: logging: noticed odd tokenization differences for some multi-lingual strings (accented punctuation) causing off-by-one tokens -> different embeddings. filed ML-4702.
Diego: please instrument tokenization trace spans in staging so we can see per-request token counts.
ops-bot: Observability note: tokenization spans enabled for staging-canary.
Noah: acceptance criteria: promote to canary 50% if int8 Recall@1 delta <=1.5% and int4 Recall@1 delta <=2.5% AND no zero-norm examples in top 1k queries.
Leah: action items: 1) Ivy run int8-perchannel asymmetric + int4 clip sweep, 2) Diego enable kd-tree radius checks and fallback rule watching, 3) QA-bot run short-query focused holdout and report exact failing examples to ML-4701, 4) Leah upload visual artifacts.
Ivy: starting run now on staging-gpu-7. queue ETA ~45m. will post results here.
Noah: thanks team. keep comments short here so we can use thread as canonical run log. :thumbsup:
